# 10ME — Design System

**Status: canonical.** Adopted from a Figma Make export (`Mobile Web App for Education`, generated by the user) which shipped its own full style reference (`src/imports/pasted_text/duolingo-style-ref.md` in that export) alongside working screens already branded for 10ME. This doc is the condensed, project-native version of that reference — implemented in `frontend/src/index.css`, `docs/kitchen-sink.html`, and the six shared components in `frontend/src/components/`. Supersedes `docs/stitch-ui-brief.md` (deprecated) and the coral/teal tokens previously started in the "10ME Design" Figma file.

## Direction

A playful, gamified language-learning look modeled on Duolingo: a white canvas dominated by one saturated brand green, with thick colored borders giving every interactive element a tactile, pressable quality. Depth comes from solid borders, never shadows or gradients. One radius (12px) used everywhere.

## Tokens

| Token | Value | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--color-brand-primary` | `#58cc02` | Primary CTA fill, active states, large numerals |
| `--color-brand-primary-border` | `#46a302` | Bottom border on filled primary buttons (pressable effect) |
| `--color-brand-secondary` | `#1cb0f6` | Secondary actions, links, "Buddy mode" surfaces |
| `--color-brand-secondary-border` | `#18a0dc` | Bottom border on filled secondary elements |
| `--color-accent-lime` | `#a5ed6e` | Outline color for ghost/secondary buttons — the system's most-repeated accent |
| `--color-accent-lime-light` | `#d7ffb8` | Soft badge backgrounds, credits-banner label text |
| `--color-text-heading` | `#042c60` | Headings, card titles, emphasis |
| `--color-text-body` | `#3c3c3c` | Default body text |
| `--color-text-secondary` | `#777777` | Labels, captions, muted text |
| `--color-text-inverse` | `#ffffff` | Text on filled-green/dark surfaces |
| `--color-border` | `#e5e5e5` | Default light border (inputs, list rows) |
| `--color-border-strong` | `#3c3c3c` | Card borders, quick-action tiles |
| `--color-success` / `--color-success-bg` | `#46a302` / `#d7ffb8` | Confirmation text / status-pill background |
| `--color-error` | `#ff4b4b` | Error text, unread-notification badge |
| `--color-warning` | `#ff9600` | Streak/flame accent |
| `--radius-md` | `12px` | The only radius in the system — cards, buttons, pills, inputs alike |
| `--font-sans` | Nunito (500/700) | Body, nav, buttons, labels — wide 0.03em letter-spacing throughout |
| `--font-display` | Inter (800/900) | Oversized numerals and headline moments only, tight -0.01to-0.02em tracking |

## Component patterns

- **Primary button**: `--color-brand-primary` fill, 2px border + 3px bottom border in `--color-brand-primary-border`, white uppercase Nunito 700 label. On press: shifts down 2px, bottom border thins to 1px. No box-shadow, ever.
- **Secondary button**: white fill, 2px border + 3px bottom border in `--color-accent-lime`, green label — the border *is* the identity, no fill.
- **Card**: white fill, 2px border + 4px bottom border in `--color-border-strong`, 12px radius, no shadow.
- **Input**: 2px border in `--color-border`, blue border on focus, red border + bold caption on error.
- **Nav item**: text-only, green when active, no background pill.
- **Credits banner**: filled `--color-brand-primary` surface with a 5px bottom border, oversized Inter 900 numeral, lime-light label text.

## Do / Don't

- Do use exactly one radius (12px) everywhere — never mix radii.
- Do use border-bottom-width as the only depth mechanism — never `box-shadow`.
- Do reserve `--font-display` for oversized numerals/headlines only — never body text.
- Don't use `--color-accent-lime` as a fill — it's a border/outline color only.
- Don't introduce new accent colors outside this palette.
